integrity: Exact integral determinant computation and field enumerations accompany a complete all-field proof. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the fixed 21-line Klein equation over fields of odd characteristic admitting a root of u^2+u+2. It does not assert modular reflection-group equivalence or characteristic-two extension. Classical complex incidence and the F7 interpretation are prior literature. Exhaustive historical priority remains provisional.
title: Uniform odd-characteristic rigidity and two point-free Klein-line complements
